results.instruction: Speak in Spanish. Imagine you've been running and have to get this message out immediately. Your voice should be panting and breathless.
results.text: Rápido, coge tus cosas y vámonos. Te lo cuento por el camino, ¡muévete!

results.instruction: Speak in Spanish. Perform this line with a hoarse, raspy voice, as if you've been shouting for hours or have a very sore throat.
results.text: Ya les he dicho mil veces que no pueden pasar por aquí, pero no escuchan.

results.instruction: Speak in Spanish. Say this with a voice that is trembling with fear, as if you're confessing something terrible and are scared of the consequences.
results.text: Fui yo quien estaba allí esa noche... no quería decirlo pero ya no puedo ocultarlo.

results.instruction: Speak in Spanish. Perform this with a weak, tired voice that lacks energy. Let your breath support fail, causing your voice to trail off at the end of phrases.
results.text: A veces me pregunto si todo el esfuerzo ha merecido la pena... o si solo era un sueño.

results.instruction: Speak in Spanish. Say this through gritted teeth, as if you are under extreme pressure and trying desperately to maintain your composure. Your voice should be tight and strained.
results.text: Sí, por supuesto, entiendo perfectamente su posición. Lo gestionaré de inmediato.

results.instruction: Speak in Spanish. Imagine you just finished a long, hard run and someone asks you a question. Your voice should be tired and you should be breathing heavily as you answer.
results.text: Vale... ya estoy aquí... en el punto de encuentro acordado.

results.instruction: Speak in Spanish. Your voice should sound thick and congested, as if you've just been crying for a long time. Try to keep it from shaking too much as you speak.
results.text: Está bien, haré lo que dices. Ya no importa de todas formas.

candidates.instruction: Speak in Spanish. Deliver the line as if you've just run up several flights of stairs to give an urgent message. Your voice should sound out of breath and hurried.
candidates.text: ¡Escucha! Tienes que salir de aquí ahora mismo, no hay tiempo para explicarlo todo.

candidates.instruction: Speak in Spanish. Your voice should be breathless, as though you just sprinted to the location to deliver this vital information.
candidates.text: Lo encontré... está en el último piso... pero tenemos que darnos prisa, ya vienen.

candidates.instruction: Speak in Spanish. Your voice should sound strained and hoarse, like you've been talking all day at a loud event.
candidates.text: Ten cuidado con él. No es quien parece ser, y ya no tengo fuerzas para advertir a nadie más.

candidates.instruction: Speak in Spanish. Deliver this with a very hoarse voice, as if you're getting over a bad cold and it hurts to talk.
candidates.text: No vayas por ese camino, es más peligroso de lo que crees. Hazme caso, por favor.

candidates.text: Fui yo quien estaba allí esa noche... no quería decirlo pero ya no puedo ocultarlo.

candidates.instruction: Speak in Spanish. Your voice should be shaky and unsteady, as though you are trying hard not to cry while speaking.
candidates.text: Creo que he cometido un error muy grande, y no sé cómo voy a solucionarlo.

candidates.instruction: Speak in Spanish. Deliver this line as if you are terrified, with your voice audibly trembling.
candidates.text: Anoche vi algo en la ventana... no era una persona, y creo que ha vuelto.

candidates.instruction: Speak in Spanish. Perform this with a weak, tired voice that lacks energy. Let your breath support fail, causing your voice to trail off at the end of phrases.
candidates.text: A veces me pregunto si todo el esfuerzo ha merecido la pena... o si solo era un sueño.

candidates.instruction: Speak in Spanish. Your delivery should sound frail and unwell, with very little breath support, as if speaking is a major effort.
candidates.text: Recuerdo los días en que todo parecía más simple... ahora todo es tan complicado.

candidates.instruction: Speak in Spanish. Use a weak, unsupported voice, like someone who is ill or exhausted. Your voice should sound thin and fade out.
candidates.text: Quizás las cosas debían ser así desde el principio... ya no tengo fuerzas para cambiarlo.

candidates.instruction: Speak in Spanish. Say this through gritted teeth, as if you are under extreme pressure and trying desperately to maintain your composure. Your voice should be tight and strained.

candidates.instruction: Speak in Spanish. Your voice should sound strained, as if you're trying to hold back a lot of anger or frustration while saying something polite.
candidates.text: No se preocupe, me aseguraré de que todo esté listo a tiempo. No hay ningún problema.

candidates.instruction: Speak in Spanish. Deliver the line with a tense, strained vocal quality. You are trying to be professional, but the stress is making your voice tight.
candidates.text: Agradezco su comentario y lo tendré en cuenta para la próxima vez.

candidates.instruction: Speak in Spanish. Perform this as if you've just sprinted a long distance. Your voice should sound breathless and reflect physical exhaustion.
candidates.text: Misión cumplida... el paquete está asegurado en la ubicación.

candidates.instruction: Speak in Spanish. Your voice should sound like you've just completed some intense physical activity, like a race. You're out of breath but trying to speak clearly.
candidates.text: Ya he terminado la última vuelta... dame un segundo... te llamo enseguida.

candidates.instruction: Speak in Spanish. Your voice should sound thick and congested, as if you've just been crying for a long time. Try to keep it from shaking too much as you speak.
candidates.text: Está bien, haré lo que dices. Ya no importa de todas formas.

candidates.instruction: Speak in Spanish. Deliver this line as someone who has just finished a heavy crying spell. Their voice is stuffy, a little shaky, and heavy with emotion.
candidates.text: Supongo que esto es todo. El tren sale en diez minutos.

candidates.instruction: Speak in Spanish. Talk as if you are trying to compose yourself after having cried hard. Your voice should be audibly affected, sounding thick and slightly hoarse.
candidates.text: No te preocupes por mí. Estaré bien, solo necesito un poco de tiempo.
